cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 58% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +3.89%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -8.13%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +12.04%
cards.body: Leaders: EOSE +12.04%, LEU +10.88%, UUUU +8.56%, FLNC +8.45%, UEC +8.13%. Laggards: VLO -9.35%, DINO -9.06%, MPC -7.53%, PSX -7.39%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
